column1: FIFA World Cup 2026 — all entries: picks & points

Each entry has two columns: PICK (the prediction) and PTS (total points scoring currently pays, rarity bonus folded in). Pts cells are colour-coded: red = 0, yellow = 1–9, green = 10–19, blue = 20+. Blank cells = the underlying result hasn't been recorded yet.
Provisional — finalized by manual review after the tournament concludes. Eligible entries only (SUBMITTED, not withdrawn or disabled).
